output.plain_english: Every week this job finds the latest closed time period and locks all earlier timesheet lines, so closed time cannot change.

steps.text: Finds the end of the latest closed period.
steps.find: SELECT MAX(period_end) FROM time_period WHERE status = 'C'

steps.text: Locks every unlocked timesheet line up to that date.

cloud_blockers.text: Direct update of the timesheet table.
